title: 3.3 What Are You Doing?
unit_title: Unit 3: Me, You and Other People
unit_outcome: Greet people, say who you are, your age, where you are from and your job, and say what belongs to whom.
goal: Ask Was machst du? / Was macht er? / Was machen sie? and answer with a Unit 1 verb.
grammar_function: Was macht er/sie? Was machst du? Was machen sie? Subject + verb.
speaking_outcome: Ask and say what someone is doing.
